feature.description: A country retreat, offering a glimpse into life at the turn of the 18th century. Featuring original wall-paintings by Sir James Thornhill.
feature.title: House

feature.description: The original formal gardens have been faithfully recreated and complement the relaxed later gardens, with orangery, orchards, and walled garden.
feature.title: Garden

feature.description: 400 acres of parkland, with remains of ancient forests and historic avenues.
feature.title: Park

feature.description: The Courtyard Kitchen is now open daily serving a range of delicious hot meals, cakes, and hot and cold drinks.
feature.title: Restaurant

feature.description: The Stables Cafe is open daily serving sandwiches, cakes, bakes, hot and cold drinks.
feature.title: Cafe

feature.description: Bookshop in the courtyard stocked full of pre-loved books.
feature.title: Second-hand bookshop

feature.description: The children's adventure playground is located behind the Stableyard and includes a swing, a slide, climbers and wooden tipis.
feature.title: Playground

cards.description:
Bring along your little ones for storytelling, babyccinos, sensory toys and colouring activities in the historic spaces in the Courtyard Kitchen.
Every Wednesday from 2 September to 18 November 10am - 11.30am. 

Bring along your little ones for storytelling and sensory activities. Enjoy the fun and take advantage of our breakfast offers.  Brunch offer which includes a sausage bap or a bacon bap (vegetarian options are also available) plus a regular hot drink £7. Babyccino 70p. 
Morning food offers until 11.30am.
cards.title: Books and Babyccinos

cards.description:
24 to 31 October 10am to 4pm
Pick up a trail booklet and pencil from Visitor Reception and embark on a mythic adventure as you discover Hanbury Hall's wonderful gardens.
cards.title: October Half-Term: Charis & the Monsters​ of the Underworld​

cards.description: Find out more and book tickets for upcoming events and activities at Hanbury Hall
cards.title: Events at Hanbury Hall

cards.description: We're inviting you to take a trip down memory lane as we celebrate Christmas 1970s and 80s style at Hanbury Hall. The tinsel will be glowing, the laughter will be flowing, the Babycham will be popping and the Slade hits will be dropping – we're turning back the clock for a nostalgic trip back in time.
cards.title: It's Christmaaas! at Hanbury Hall

cards.description: Hanbury Hall is full of fun adventures for all the family. There’s always lots to do to keep little ones busy in the great outdoors, from exploring the playground, seasonal trails, to ticking off some of our 50 things to do at Hanbury Hall activities.
cards.title: Family days out at Hanbury Hall

cards.description: Enjoy the gardens and parkland at Hanbury Hall. From the Walled Garden to Kytes Orchard and beyond, the outdoors at Hanbury look beautiful throughout the year.
cards.title: Things to see and do in the gardens and parkland

cards.description: Discover Hanbury Hall, a William and Mary-style country house built by wealthy lawyer Thomas Vernon in the early 18th century.
cards.title: Things to see and do in the Hall

cards.description: Relax and enjoy a bite to eat after exploring Hanbury Hall in the Courtyard Kitchen and the Stables Cafe.
cards.title: Eating at Hanbury Hall

cards.description: Enjoy an easy walk across Hanbury's parkland, admiring sweeping views of the hall and estate and discovering fascinating historic landscape features.
